up: List all compounds that are referenced in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1240340 (i.e., the document whose chembl_id is 'CHEMBL1240340' in the docs table). For each compound, return the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Include each qualifying compound only once (distinct compounds). Do not apply any additional filters such as on activity data or target types. The document is linked to compounds through compound_records: each compound_record belongs to a document and references a molecule via molregno. The molecule_dictionary and compound_structures tables are linked via molregno to provide the requested molecule attributes.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240340';
